value.name: Miles argues Bonnie's husband is suspicious
value.description: Miles tells Bonnie that her husband's taking of the pictures and the pool man's presence make the husband look suspicious.
evidence: Yes. Your husband did show remarkable foresight in taking those pictures. And, yes, absent a swimming pool, the presence of the pool man would appear to be suspicious.

value.name: Miles reframes Bonnie as the real victim
value.description: Miles shifts the blame away from Bonnie and asks her to consider who the real victim is in the situation.
evidence: But Bonnie, who is the real victim here? Let me suggest the following.
